reader: Same AI reader, 2026-10-19; all 22 originally unscorable boundaries inspected at 3x with context and original-coordinate rulers, without OCR-box overlays. This is post-exposure adjudication, not fresh validation or a second independent reader.
protocol: Revise whitespace partitions from scans only. Keep original identities and center cores. For ambiguous interior colored guides or isolated recitation signs, optional ink specifies explicit ownership alternatives; horizontal edges may be usable only if they are identical for every subset between mandatory and possible masks. This does not certify full linguistic mark ownership. The separate magenta ta stop sign above nakidan is excluded as nonlexical notation; its black letters and tanwin remain.
